traits.name: Thievery
traits.text: +7 Str +0, Dex +4, Con +2, Int –1, Wis +1, Cha +3 Items baton (light mace), dagger.

traits.name: Distracting Frolic
traits.text: ⬲ (fortune, manipulate); Trigger An ally within 10 feet of the dancer rolls a saving throw against a mental or illusion effect. The target ally can roll the save twice and take the better result.

traits.name: Death Flare
traits.text: (light); When the dancer dies, their body combusts in a flare of white light. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1d4 (1d4) rounds. Calignis that fail this save are also frightened 1. The dancer's gear and treasure are left in a pile where they died. As this isn't a magical effect, the light has no effect within magical darkness.

traits.name: Dancer's Curse
traits.text: ⬻ (curse, enchantment, occult, mental); The caligni dancer touches a foe and curses it. If the target fails a DC 18 Will save, it gains clumsy 1 and stupefied 1. The target is then temporarily immune for 24 hours. These conditions persist until the curse is removed. The victim can attempt a new DC 18 Will save once per hour to end the curse.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The caligni dancer deals 1d6 (1d6) extra precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

actions.text: ⬻ dagger +9 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d4 (1d4) piercing
